description: Linux enumerates the configured processor count
Every configured processor accepts an affinity-bound task
CPU0 exchanges 256 ordered wakeups with every AP
Every AP receives a reschedule IPI during cross-CPU wakeup
All-excluding-self shorthand delivers an NMI to every AP
CPU1 completes an offline and online INIT/SIPI cycle
Monotonic time and timer wakeups advance while the guest sleeps
Fresh anonymous pages are zero and copy-on-write is isolated
Affinity-bound SIMD workloads retain deterministic FPU state
The virtio block device is enumerated
Repeated block write/read completions preserve data
The virtio network link can be enabled
Raw Ethernet transmit descriptors complete repeatedly
